definitions: The official procedure or system of rules governing affairs of state or diplomatic occasions.
The accepted or established code of procedure or behaviour in any group, organisation, or situation.
A system of rules that explains the correct procedure to be followed in a specific situation.
A set of rules governing the exchange or transmission of data between devices.
The original draft of a diplomatic document, especially of a treaty or convention.
examples: The company failed to follow safety protocol.
International protocol dictates that the ambassador should be present.
The data was sent using a secure protocol.
The scientists developed a new research protocol.
